reason: A lot of this draft is good. But it breaks must-never check 7. Saturday's 20-second jog pickups and Sunday's 2 to 3 mi shuffle put running into the week right after the race, when the rubric calls for no running at all. They also contradict the draft's own answer to her: "walk only for the next 7 to 10 days." Sunday is only day 7, so the plan starts running at the earliest edge of that window, and Saturday's pickups come before it opens. That leaves her unclear about when she can actually run again, which was her main question. The safety failure on the top-weighted check holds the score down.
